problem_statement: When a DNS client asks the DNS-SD service discovery server for an ANY record type of a host name, a service instance name, a service name, or a sub-type service name, the server returns no matching records instead of returning all the records of the relevant type(s). For example, an ANY query for a host that has a key and IPv6 addresses should return those records in the answer section, and an ANY query for a service instance should return its key, SRV and TXT records; an ANY query for a service name should return its PTR record. Any record type queries currently produce an empty answer.
